name: KaiserStation
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to KaiserStation in Ellmau – your gateway to the breathtaking **Zillertal Alps**!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this world-class ski resort offers **360° panoramic views** of the **Hochzillertal** valley and the majestic **Wildspitze** peak. Whether you're a seasoned skier, a snowboarder, or a family looking for fun, KaiserStation delivers **120 km of perfectly groomed slopes** for all levels—from gentle nursery runs to thrilling black runs.

After an exhilarating day on the slopes, warm up with a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a creamy **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a frothy **Apfelstrudel** at one of our cozy mountain huts. For the little ones, the **KaiserKids** area ensures endless fun with sledding hills, a mini train, and playful snow activities.

In summer, KaiserStation transforms into a paradise for hikers, mountain bikers, and nature lovers. Explore the **Almwiesen** (alpine meadows), take the **Zillertal Arena gondola** to the top, or simply relax with a refreshing **Radler** (beer-mix drink) at our alpine terrace.

**Discover adventure, relaxation, and pure **Tiroler Gemütlichkeit** at KaiserStation in Ellmau!**
